policy: Preserve reviewed Matthew and all checkpointed chapter alignments during automated repair and deployment. Review both alignment directions. Corrected records a bilingual correction pass; verified requires explicit final bilingual verification and regression evidence. Record deployment separately with evidence. Certification requires verification and successful deployment of the same chapter content. Resume at the recorded chapter.
